about: Residue of the P0-M-2 port check (tests/db/test_port_check.py): each difference of the generated MetaData plus overlay from D3's DDL (d3_ddl.sql), keyed as the comparator names it, with its reason. Every item is by design; the BM25 kind list, the residue of probe Q-3, now matches D3.

residue.ops.run only generated unique ('id', 'sc: The target of the schema-version tie FKs from kb.entity and kb.claim (P0-M-2 decision); D3 §4 does not list it yet.
residue.kb.segment only generated check parse_re: An empty or whitespace-only parse reason is no reason (P0-M-2 decision, coordinator): KbSegment.parse_reason declares pattern '\S', which the generated validator kb_segment also applies; D3 §5 does not list it yet.
residue.kb.embedding column vec type: The model's HalfVec type has no dimension: it is the EmbeddingSpec's, fixed by S7 (OPEN-D3-2); D3's halfvec(1024) is one of the two candidates.
residue.kb.embedding index embedding_hnsw_alias: kb.embedding is created by the phase 1 migration that adds M04, not 0001 (D3 §5); its HNSW indexes need the halfvec dimension, which waits on S7 (OPEN-D3-2), so the overlay does not declare them yet.
residue.kb.embedding index embedding_hnsw_entity: kb.embedding is created by the phase 1 migration that adds M04, not 0001 (D3 §5); its HNSW indexes need the halfvec dimension, which waits on S7 (OPEN-D3-2), so the overlay does not declare them yet.

residue.kb.entity only generated foreign key ('s: The schema-version tie (P0-M-2 decision): the row's run FK is the composite (schema_version_id, run_id) -> ops.run (schema_version_id, id), declared ci:same: schema_version on the run slot, so the row's schema version is its run's (INV-03 then holds through the version-scoped FKs). It keeps the run slot's ON DELETE CASCADE.
residue.kb.entity only reference foreign key ('r: Replaced by the composite tie FK (same columns plus schema_version_id, same ON DELETE CASCADE).
residue.kb.entity only reference foreign key ('s: Implied by the tie: a NOT NULL composite FK sharing schema_version_id with ops.run already makes the column a valid schema version, so the compiler emits no FK of its own (one probe fewer per row on COPY).
residue.kb.entity index entity_kind: Supporting index of a composite FK that no key or index starts with (coordinator decision 18; probe Q-4, p0q.fk-cost: without one, deleting a run's entities took 9.3 s, with it 32 ms); D3 §5 does not list it yet. FK (schema_version_id, kind) -> meta.statement_kind; partial, as kind is null for non-statements.
residue.kb.entity index entity_resolved_to: Supporting index of a composite FK that no key or index starts with (coordinator decision 18; probe Q-4, p0q.fk-cost: without one, deleting a run's entities took 9.3 s, with it 32 ms); D3 §5 does not list it yet. FK (run_id, resolved_to_id) -> kb.entity (run_id, id), the self-reference that run deletion checks per entity; partial.

FK (run_id, attribution_entity_id) -> kb.entity; the index Q-4 measured; partial.

FK (schema_version_id, modality) -> meta.claim_modality, checked per member row deleted or re-projected.

FK (schema_version_id, predicate) -> meta.schema_slot (INV-03), checked per slot row deleted or re-projected.
residue.meta.payload_schema only generated check: A payload schema's first version, and only it, has no parent (P0-M-4): PayloadSchema declares iff_absent(parent, compatibility_class = initial); D3 §3 does not list it yet.
compatibility_class is the modelled closed set CompatibilityClass (P0-M-4; ADR-0022's seven classes and initial); D3 §3 has it as free text.
residue.kb.segment column ts_config default: The default is cast, 'english'::regconfig, as PostgreSQL stores it (P0-F-4): Alembic compares a server default by evaluating <reflected> = <metadata> on the server, and the uncast literal resolves regconfig = unknown as oid = oid and fails with 22P02 (probe Q-3). D3 §5 writes DEFAULT 'english'.
residue.ops.method column confidence_source: The method's declared ConfidenceSource, recorded beside its tier so the policy's confidence blocks have a key (orchestration §3.2, §3.10; DA-016; P0-O-1); D3 §4 does not list it yet.
residue.ops.method only generated check confiden: The method's declared ConfidenceSource, recorded beside its tier so the policy's confidence blocks have a key (orchestration §3.2, §3.10; DA-016; P0-O-1); D3 §4 does not list it yet. The CHECK is ConfidenceSource's member list.
residue.kb.entity_identity only generated foreig: ON DELETE CASCADE added (P0-C-1, 2026-10-29): rebuilding a run deletes its entities in one statement, and a non-cascading reference from one entity's identity row to another entity of the run was refused depending on trigger order; identity rows go with either entity (D3 §8).
residue.kb.entity_identity only reference foreig: D3's form without ON DELETE CASCADE; replaced by the cascading FK above (P0-C-1).
residue.kb.entity column reference_descriptor: C2-01 (operator-approved consolidation/query execution, 2026-10-29): sys:KbEntity.reference_descriptor in model 0.4.0 adds the nullable stored-descriptor JSONB column, realized by migration 0002. It preserves unresolved-reference meaning across materialization; historical NULL remains unknown. The frozen d3_ddl.sql reference (34cd2a8) predates this addition; current D3 section 5 declares it.
residue.kb.entity column statement_ordinal: C2 statement reconstruction (operator-approved execution, 2026-10-29): sys:KbEntity.statement_ordinal in model 0.5.0 adds the nullable first-sentence ordinal, realized by migration 0003. It preserves order among statements sharing an anchor; historical NULL remains unknown. The frozen d3_ddl.sql reference (34cd2a8) predates this addition; current D3 section 5 declares it.
residue.kb.claim_entity_ref only generated check: DA-007/F04 unresolved endpoints (operator-approved execution, 2026-10-29): model 0.5.0 sys:EntityRefRole adds condition_premise and binding_param for ExternalReference nodes in claim-valued reference positions. Migration 0003 widens this generated CHECK. These roles preserve relationship kind and path instead of relabelling unresolved premises as predicate arguments. Current D3 section 5 carries all six roles; the frozen reference predates the change.
residue.kb.claim_entity_ref only reference check: The four-member EntityRefRole CHECK in frozen d3_ddl.sql (34cd2a8) is superseded by model 0.5.0 and migration 0003, whose generated six-member CHECK is recorded separately above. The old members remain admitted; only the two explicit unresolved claim-position roles are added.
